subject.title: feat(hooks): add ACP turn transcript save hook

question: Should OpenClaw add an `agent:turn:transcript:save` internal hook contract that reports ACP transcript persistence outcomes and changes ACP completion ordering around the save callback?
rationale: This is a new hook/API surface with session-state timing implications, so code review can identify defects but cannot decide whether the product should own the contract.

options.title: Sponsor and harden
options.body: Accept the hook direction, then require the known-event registry/test update, fresh validation, and explicit acceptance of the ACP save-order boundary before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer
options.body: Keep the transcript-save idea out of this PR and route it through the broader lifecycle-hooks design work before adding a durable contract.

options.title: Close as unsponsored
options.body: Close this split branch if maintainers do not want OpenClaw core to own transcript-save durability hooks now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and harden
recommendation.body: Accept the hook direction, then require the known-event registry/test update, fresh validation, and explicit acceptance of the ACP save-order boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership touches both the hook validator registry and the ACP paths this PR extends.
